learning_objective: 🎯 Become a master builder by using a compass and ruler to draw perfectly precise geometric shapes!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: To construct perfect shapes, we use a ruler for drawing perfectly straight lines and a compass for drawing smooth, flawless circles. These are the tools of a true architect!

A compass has a sharp metal point that acts as the center, and a pencil point that spins around it. The distance between the metal point and the pencil is called the radius, and it stays the same all the way around!

fun_activity.title: 🎯 The Perfect Mandala
fun_activity.instructions: Place the metal point of your compass in the center of a blank page and draw a circle. Keep the metal point in the same spot, open the compass a little wider, and draw another circle around it to start a beautiful mandala!

quick_recap: ⭐ Construction in math means drawing shapes accurately using specific tools.
⭐ A ruler is used to measure lengths and draw straight line segments.
⭐ A compass guarantees that every point on your circle is the exact same distance from the center.
